image_description: An interior view of a rustic, wooden lumbermill or sawmill. A man in work clothes and a cap stands operating a large, vintage band saw mechanism. A cut log section sits on the carriage in the foreground. The room is constructed of rough-hewn timber beams and planks, with sunlight streaming through windows in the background, illuminating dust particles in the air. Various mechanical components, wheels, and belts are visible on the right side.
